scripts.test: ! git ls-files ':(glob)**/.gitattributes' | grep . || { echo 'remove the .gitattributes listed above: it changes the archive codeload.github.com serves' >&2; exit 1; }; out=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/build.XXXXXX") && tsc6 -p . --outDir "$out" && { diff -r dist/ts "$out"; s=$?; rm -r "$out"; test $s -eq 0; } && node --test 'tests/api/*.api.spec.ts' && tstyche
